newsitem.title: USA: Qwest in $20 mln fiber optics route deal.
newsitem.headline: Qwest in $20 mln fiber optics route deal.

text.p: Qwest Communications International Inc said Wednesday that it has agreed to sell additional routes on its optic fiber network to a "major" telecommunications provider in a deal valued at more than $20 million.
Tony Brodman, Qwest's senior vice president for strategy and planning, citing a confidentiality agreement, declined to name the company.
The transaction involves the sale of fiber optics routes only and does not include add-on electronics, Brodman said.
Qwest is building a 13,000-mile fiber optics network and already has agreements to provide routes to some major carriers, including GTE Corp and Frontier Corp, he said.
The company said the latest deal will be completed early next year and that the contract includes optios for Quest to build additional routes to the unidentified company.
